senses.gloss:
प्याट् प्याट्, ind. a particle used in calling,
ho! holla!
प्याय् प्याय्. See rt. प्यै below.

प्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, fat, swollen, grown fat, =
पीन, q. v.

प्यायन, अस्, ई, अम्, promoting growth or in-
crease (according to a Scholiast = वृद्धि-हेतु),
causing to thrive; invigorating; (अम्), n. growth,
increase.

प्यायित, अस्, आ, अम्, fat, grown fat; increased;
strengthened, refreshed; = पीन, q. v.
